title: Provider runner handoff outbox consumer
objective: 新增一个本地 outbox consumer CLI，用于消费 ProviderAdapterRunnerHandoffOutbox v0.1 并批量运行 provider adapter runner 的离线 fixture / video boundary，生成 receipt/envelope 与执行报告；默认不调用 provider、不读取 .env、不导入后端、不 staging/promotion、不激活 runtime。
acceptance_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from backend.app.services.generation_scheduler_handoff_builders import build_provider_adapter_runner_handoff, build_provider_adapter_runner_handoff_outbox
request=json.loads(Path('examples/provider_adapter_runs/p1b_provider_adapter_runner.executor_request.json').read_text())
auth=json.loads(Path('examples/provider_authorizations/p1b_provider_execution_authorization.example.json').read_text())
source=request['source']
handoff=build_provider_adapter_runner_handoff(session_id=source['session_id'], run_id=source['run_id'], schedule_item_id=source['schedule_item_id'], authorization_ref=auth['authorization_ref'], executor_request_id=request['request_id'], executor_request=request, authorization=auth, provider_profile=auth['source']['provider_profile'], created_at='2026-07-07T00:00:00+00:00', note='outbox consumer acceptance fixture')
outbox=build_provider_adapter_runner_handoff_outbox(session_id=source['session_id'], run_id=source['run_id'], worker_id='outbox-consumer-acceptance', max_items=1, dispatched_count=1, stop_reason='acceptance_fixture', runner_handoffs=[handoff], created_at='2026-07-07T00:00:00+00:00')
Path('/tmp/provider_runner_handoff_outbox_consumer_fixture.v0.1.json').write_text(json.dumps(outbox, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
PY
notes: 本任务只做外部 runner outbox 的本地 dry boundary consumer，不接入 live provider。
consumer 输出 receipt/envelope 和 report 到 /tmp；导入后端仍需显式使用 handoff 的 import_after_runner 合同。
video mode 只是离线边界，finish_reason 应表达真实 video live provider 未实现。
该工具不改变 queue 状态，不 staging，不 promotion，不 runtime activation，不写世界状态。
